SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) trading
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctl_sales, w.net_sales-c.ctl_sales gap
FROM weekly w JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_line_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_prod,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ztest,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_undispatched,
  MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) e0, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) e1
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) dist_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) dist_sl,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_store, SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_prod,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_sale,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ztest,
 SUM(r.refund_net) refunds
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=129 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) savonlinna,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=125 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) kuopio,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) web,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id IN (136,137) THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) new_stores
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
